gap: No result ChatGPT got states what each under-$500 station costs per watt-hour it actually delivers from its AC outlets (price paid ÷ a named reviewer's measured output), or how fast each drains itself with the outlets left on: on The Solar Lab's and GearLab's measurements the DJI Power 1000 V2 is $0.43-$0.45 per delivered Wh against about $0.53-$0.54 for the Anker C1000 Gen 2 and EcoFlow DELTA 3 Classic, and the 700 W BLUETTI Elite 100 mini is $0.37.
standout_why: Compared against PopSci (the cited page), willitrunpower, outagepowerguide, juicebench and powersized, all opened 2026-11-27. PopSci gives prices and specs only, with no per-Wh, efficiency, idle or runtime figure. Juicebench publishes price per rated Wh only ($0.43-$0.69), from Nov 5-6 prices. Powersized gives price, capacity and weight with no ratios. Willitrunpower is the closest: it computes runtime with a flat 0.85 factor and a flat 15 W idle for every model, and it covers none of the stations ChatGPT named (DJI Power 1000 V2, DELTA 3 Classic, C1000 Gen 2, Elite 100 mini). Outagepowerguide divides rated Wh by load with no losses. None uses a per-model measured efficiency or idle draw, which is where these 1 kWh units differ (80-97% and 13.5-18 W).
decides: It confirms the DJI Power 1000 V2 as the pick among stations that run a kettle or microwave: $379.99 buys the most delivered Wh per dollar there, although it is the heaviest (32.5 Wh/lb) and drains itself fastest with the outlets on (18 W, about 42% of the battery a day). It gives our BLUETTI Elite 100 mini an honest segment win for loads under 700 W and long low-draw outages: lowest cost per delivered Wh, joint-lowest idle draw (13.5 W, about 74 h outlet-on standby) and the best Wh/lb. That win survives cutting The Solar Lab's outlier 97% to the 86% it measured on the Anker (360.05 ÷ 864.1 = $0.42). The Anker's case is its 2,000 W output, 13.8 W idle and 41 Wh/lb, not cost per Wh. The BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 measures worst on cost per delivered Wh ($0.60-$0.64) and is over $500 at BLUETTI's store.
